author: The Current
description:
Watch José González describe how classical guitar informs his music
Support The Current: https://support.mpr.org/youtube or hit the Thanks button

JIn a conversation with The Current’s Mac Wilson, Swedish singer-songwriter Jose Gonzalez talks about his experience as a student of classical guitar and how it informed his music and the title of his new song, “Etyd” (Swedish for “étude”). 

Watch the full session here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=g7BUW4QppdM

José González’s 2026 album, Against the Dying of the Light, is available on Mute Records @themutechannel.
